name: bizplug-utilities
description: The utilities & energy plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: outage and service-request status. It works from the business's own published profile, covering how to report outages, service setup and billing questions, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Outage and service-request status for utilities & energy businesses.

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls lookup_service_status and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: How do I report an outage or set up service?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls report_issue only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
